name: Gangtok, Darjeeling, with East Sikkim trip
route: PICKUP from Siliguri/NUP/Bagdogra → Gangtok → EAST SIKKIM trip → Gang → Darjeeling → TIGER HILL and OTHER

itinerary.title: PICKUP from Siliguri/NUP/Bagdogra
itinerary.desc: Hotel on MG ROAD (no extra travelling cost) Visit MG MARG and LAL MARKET in 1 min walk

itinerary.title: Local sight seeing in Gangtok
itinerary.desc: Includes 7 points in and around Gangtok Experience Ropeway of Gangtok Orchidarium Tashi view point Hanuman Tok & Ganesh Tok Bulbulay Falls (enjoy Zipline adventure) Enchey Monastery Himalayan Zoological Park Stay in Gangtok "In East Sikkim, even the clouds seem to pause and admire the view."

itinerary.title: Gangtok to EAST SIKKIM trip
itinerary.desc: Visit the magical Tsomgo lake, Experience highest ropeway in Asia (14,000 ft) Nathula pass (indochina border) Baba Harbhajan Singh Mandir Stay in Gangtok "Darjeeling feels like breathing deeper."

itinerary.title: Gangtok to Darjeeling
itinerary.desc: Check into the hotel. Enjoy local cafes and food Darjeeling town. Go for Toy Train Ride and evening will be for leisure. Overnight stay in Darjeeling

itinerary.title: TIGER HILL and OTHER LOCAL SIGHTSEEING
itinerary.desc: Start your day early morning at 3 am. First point will be the Tiger Hill and then we will visit the Batasia Loop & the Tea Garden. Visit Local sightseeing like Ghoom Monastery, Himalayan Zoological Park, Japanese Peace Pagoda Darjeeling to NJP/Bagdogra/Siliguri we provide exact drop to RAILWAY STATION, AIRPORT and HOTELS

inclusions: Accommodation in double, triple and quad sharing (Standard rooms)
exclusions: Any kind of activity charges and entry fees
Package Cost: Starting from 10,900 only per person
essentialTips: 4. Reusable Water Bottle (Xuse and throw bottles not allowed)
8. Oxygen can for North & East Sikkim you can purchase after reaching Gangtok)
